description_en: Queries the details of a specified service endpoint, including target routing, access URLs, authentication configuration, and current status
description_zh: 查询指定服务端点的详细信息，包括目标路由、访问地址、鉴权配置和当前状态
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-service-endpoint --workspace-id ws-123456 --service-endpoint-id se-123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetServiceEndpoint

accessUrls.description_en: The access URL list of the service endpoint
accessUrls.description_zh: 服务端点的访问地址列表

accessType.description_en: The access URL type. Valid values: INTERNET, VPC

status.description_en: The access URL status. Valid values: CREATING, READY, DEGRADED

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the access URL status. A specific reason is returned when the status is degraded
statusReason.description_zh: 访问地址状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

authentication.description_en: The authentication configuration of the service endpoint

type.description_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:
NONE: no authentication required.
API_KEY: authentication by passing an API key through the x-api-key request header
type.description_zh: 鉴权方式。NONE 表示无需鉴权，API_KEY 表示通过 x-api-key 请求头传递 API Key 进行鉴权

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

endpointType.description_en:
The service endpoint type. Valid values:
DEFAULT: a default endpoint created and maintained by the platform.
NAMED: a named endpoint explicitly created by the user
endpointType.description_zh: 服务端点类型。DEFAULT 表示由平台创建并维护的默认端点，NAMED 表示用户显式创建的命名端点

name.description_en: The service endpoint name. The name is unique within the workspace and is 1 to 128 characters in length
name.description_zh: 服务端点名称。在工作空间内唯一，长度为 1~128 个字符

regionId.description_en: The region ID where the service endpoint resides
regionId.description_zh: 服务端点所在的地域 ID

status.description_en: The service endpoint status. Valid values: CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DEGRADED, DISABLED, DELETING

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the service endpoint status. A specific reason is returned when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 服务端点状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

target.description_en: The target routing configuration of the service endpoint
target.description_zh: 服务端点的目标路由配置

agentId.description_en: The target agent ID. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentId.description_zh: 目标智能体 ID。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

agentVersion.description_en: The target agent version number. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentVersion.description_zh: 目标智能体版本号。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

collaborationComponent.description_en: The collaboration component type. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
collaborationComponent.description_zh: 协作组件类型。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

resourceBindingId.description_en: The workspace resource binding ID associated with the target collaboration component. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
resourceBindingId.description_zh: 目标协作组件关联的工作空间资源绑定 ID。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

targetType.description_en: The target type. Valid values: AGENT_VERSION, TEAM_COLLABORATION

updatedAt.description_en: The last modification time in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
